text:
eli (partnerships): VerdantAI uploaded weights claiming "commercial redistribution" but no sigs. Need to triage redistribution scope, export, and announcement cadence.

rosa (legal): Ask for signed release (sigstore/GPG), contributor CLAs, full license matrix. Clarify whether 'commercial redistribution' includes downloads, hardware bundles, or resale. CC-BY/CC-BY-SA datasets change everything.

provenance-bot: SCAN: no verified signatures found. FLAG: provenance_missing (HIGH).

sam (marketplace): Until proofs arrive, set listing to hosted-only + badge "redistribution pending". Prepare flags: attribution_required=true, redistribution_allowed=false by default.

kai (product): Product prefers hosted + Dedicated canary (5% traffic) with telemetry and auto-revert on takedown. Require quantized builds and perf numbers for any redistribution approval.

harpreet (hw): Hardware bundling needs explicit binary redistribution grant, package signing, and a vulnerability contact. Also a short SOW for device preload.

eli (partnerships): Action items: (1) I'll request sigs, CLAs, SBoM, dataset manifests, and export-origin statement (ETA 72h). (2) Rosa to draft an attestation template + redistribution clause (ETA 48h). (3) Sam to stage listing flags and marketing-hold checklist. (4) Kai to prepare canary config. Scheduling a 20-min sync with VerdantAI + Legal tomorrow 11:00 PT.

rosa (legal): Draft redistribution snippet: "Provider grants Redwood non-exclusive right to host the Model; distribution of binaries to third parties or hardware partners requires Provider's prior written consent. Provider warrants rights to grant such licenses and that no ShareAlike obligations apply."

sam (marketplace): Adding note: co-marketing requires legal_clearance==true and 2-week review. No joint blog until cleared.

eli (partnerships): Thanks all. Please post templates and links here when ready. :thumbsup:
